line: A woodblock print in motion: flat colour fields, keyblock lines, Prussian-blue water and a gradient sky.
line_cn: 会动的浮世绘版画：平涂色块、墨线轮廓、普鲁士蓝的水和渐变的天。
lineage: Structure after lemo-opuscar STYLE.md (CC BY 4.0); text written for the H3 pipeline.
essence: Flat, unmodelled colour fields separated by a thin dark keyblock line.
Bokashi gradients in the sky and water; registration slightly imperfect at the edges.
Steep, stacked perspective: near things large and low, far things small and high, no vanishing point.
Patterns (waves, rain, textile) drawn as repeating marks, not textures.
Stillness with one moving thing: a wave, a traveller, rain.
not: Not anime: no cel shading, no large eyes.
Not a photo with a print filter: no photographic depth of field.
Not Chinese ink wash: colour is flat and full, not tonal.
materials: Washi paper ground with mulberry fibre; ink sits in it slightly.
Keyblock line, uniform width, warm black.
Colour blocks with bokashi gradients at horizon and water; small registration misfit allowed.

rules: Five to seven flat colours per print; Prussian blue for water and distance.
The sky is a gradient band, the ground a flat field; mid-tones are rare.
One accent (a red lantern, an orange gate) placed once.
colour.examplePalette: washi #efe4cf, Prussian blue #1f3f6e, indigo #2c2c4a, vermilion #c5402b, ochre #d1a24a, pine #3f6b4f

type.titleFont: a vertical cartouche; Noto Serif JP bold
type.subtitleFont: Noto Serif JP regular, warm black
type.placement: a vertical cartouche top-left or right for titles; subtitles bottom on the paper
rules: Titles may sit inside a rectangular cartouche added by the assembler.
Most of the frame holds still; one element moves in a repeating pattern.
Motion is stepped and graphic, like a flip of printed sheets.
Rain and waves loop; people walk in two or three poses.

grammar.expresses: the print as object; one thing moves inside it
the vertical print, sky to foreground

grammar.note: from a detail to the full sheet
grammar.expresses: the detail belongs to a whole

framing: Stacked planes: foreground large and cropped, middle ground, a far mountain small and high.
Leave a cartouche-sized rectangle clear for titles.

sound.ambience: the place of the print: shore, rain, a market, a mountain road
sound.silence: the clapper strikes once and everything stops; one held print
sound.voice: measured, like a travel diary read aloud

nativeMoves.name: The loop print
nativeMoves.what: One thing repeats forever inside a still print: a wave, rain, a flag.
nativeMoves.build: loop link, FL2VA with the hero frame as first and last frame, repeat on the timeline.

nativeMoves.name: Stations of a road
nativeMoves.what: A series of prints, one per place, same sky band.
nativeMoves.build: montage shots, 5 s each, static camera, consistent grade, cut on the beat.

nativeMoves.name: Registration shift
nativeMoves.what: The colour blocks slide off the keyblock and back.
nativeMoves.build: assembler effect over a cut, or a beat 'the colours slip a little and settle'.

nativeMoves.name: Cartouche title
nativeMoves.what: The title appears inside a printed rectangle.
nativeMoves.build: assembler title with a flat colour box; the model never draws text.

pitfalls.problem: The model renders depth of field and soft shading.
pitfalls.fix: Say 'flat colour fields, no shading, thin dark outline' in the beat suffix; dof deep.
Keep figures small or in profile; describe faces as 'a few printed lines'.
Describe stacked planes: 'the far mountain sits high and small'.

look.genre: animated ukiyo-e woodblock print, Edo-period travel series
look.palette: flat printed colour fields, Prussian blue water, bokashi gradient sky, one vermilion accent
look.camera: static prints with one moving element, slow pans across stations
look.lens: flat graphic perspective, stacked planes, no vanishing point
look.lighting: no cast light; colour fields carry the hour

negative: no shading or gradients on figures
engine.beatSuffix: Everything is a flat woodblock print with thin dark outlines and bokashi gradients on washi paper.

structures: one print whose single moving thing changes meaning three times
openings: a blank washi sheet, the keyblock printed first
a cartouche with the title before any picture
endings: the full sheet pulled out to show the series on a wall
the print lifted off the block
